headlineFindings: City-hub mega-template (v1.6.0): 70 records carry all five template vectors (season all-12 9/8/9/8 + crowd 5/8/9 + comfort 8/8/3 + visit 6-12h + walking 4000/1500/2500m); 119 carry >=4 of them.
pipeline.cjs defaults: crowd {3,4,5} (81), season {4,4,4,4} (44), bestMonths [3,4,5,9,10,11] (391 records), walking 60/40 sun/shade split (376 records), walkingMin 8000 default (30).

expand-major-city-catalog.ts (v1.9.2): hash-generated fractional season scores (rating() = 6.2+(hash%34)/10; 291 records fractional), comfort = indoorPercent/10 formula (204 exact), crowd {5,8,9} (part of 346), walking metre templates 6500/4000/2500 (74) and 3000/500/2500 (20).

Walking unit inconsistency: 424 metre-like (>=1000) vs 335 minute-like (<1000); 430 records violate WALKING_MIN_IMPLAUSIBLE (baselined); 1 published violation of WALKING_SUN_SHADE_EXCEEDS_TOTAL (ginza-itoya).
Metadata integrity: manual/high confidence attached to template values (45x {6,12} visit, 57x all-12 season, 46x crowd 5/8/9, 60x comfort 8/8/3).
Kind labels unreliable in expansion data: fushimi-inari-taisha, kamakurakokomae-station, canal-city-hakata labeled 'museum' with indoorPercent 20.

contractNotes: walkingMin/walkingSunMin/walkingShadeMin are REQUIRED numbers in Destination (destination.ts) — the contract does NOT permit nulling today. Two options: (a) amend the type to optional and confidence-gate rendering (pattern already proven by PR #174 for ratingMetadata/NaN), or (b) migrate the 424 metre-like records (>=1000) to minutes per the 8d47f316 precedent (Okinawa repair) using per-record evidence. Do NOT bulk-convert by formula.

Unit semantics are undocumented in the type and inconsistent in data: 424 records use metres (>=1000), 335 use minutes (<1000), 219 lack walking entirely. Runtime consumers assume metres (DestinationCard 'Low sun' threshold walkingSunMin<3000; Destinations.tsx sort by walkingMin; pipeline.cjs walkingIntensity thresholds 4000/8000) while the validator and the 8d47f316 fix assume minutes.

Precision: values like 1500/2500/4000 are synthetically precise; the contract permits any finite number >=0, so precision cannot be 'removed' without either rounding (no-op) or nulling (type change). Confidence-gating (low/unknown rendering) is the compatible route; PR #174 already renders missing values defensively.
heatTolerance/rainFriendly identity (489/739 records) means the pair is effectively one signal today; field semantics (independent dimensions vs indoor-derived proxy) need an editorial decision.

recommendedVisitHours on hubs is consumed by WeekendAreaPolicy/WeekendPolicy (ownMinutes) and getVisitBand — dropping hub visit hours changes weekend-area classification; the {6,12} template should be either documented as the 'full-day hub' convention or re-derived from child POIs, not left as unexplained template data.

Season scores for template vectors: do NOT invent 0-10 values. The PR #174 confidence-gate (missing/low ratingMetadata -> 0.5 weight) already neutralizes assisted/low records in scoring; extend the same gating to template-signature values flagged by the new validators.
